rule: Claims are claim-specific. Reproduced negative results may be GREEN for reproducibility while superiority remains unsupported.

claims.primary_claim: The frozen ARC validation comparison is reproducibly negative/inconclusive for model superiority and does not establish planner or target benefit.
supported: Frozen ARC validation result reproduces at the aggregate scientific-conclusion level.
Matched supervised mean exceeds the full-model mean in the retained five-seed comparison.
Planner and target ablations do not establish positive mechanism contribution.
claims.falsifier_or_gate: A positive superiority/mechanism claim would require a separately frozen protocol where the full model beats dangerous controls and mechanism ablations show predeclared positive effects; the current result is not retuned.

claims.primary_claim: The retained development package shows a robustness-adaptation tradeoff and fails the current >=10% abrupt-regime promotion gate.
supported: Development abrupt-regime improvement is approximately 5.33-5.36% under the retained comparison.
PCRW is not cleanly better than Huber.
Coherent burst outliers are adverse.
claims.falsifier_or_gate: v0.2/current candidate already fails its frozen development gate. Any successor must be separately versioned and preregistered before reserved confirmatory seeds.

claims.primary_claim: A typed/validated compiler improves the frozen controlled held-out-template benchmark over direct flat extraction and produces executable STL for the frozen valid cases.
supported: Held-out-template overall: typed/validated 19/20 versus direct 12/20.
Frozen valid cases produce non-empty STL 12/12 through OpenSCAD.
The O018 negative-width failure remains preserved.
non_claims: OOD generalization to new geometry families
claims.falsifier_or_gate: Same-provider learned direct-generation baseline parity/win or failure on preregistered new-part-family OOD defeats a broader research claim.

claims.primary_claim: Source-level gates are strong, while production certification remains incomplete because exact served revision identity and the authenticated golden journey are not both established.
supported: Current public production smoke boundaries other than revision identity pass in the retained 2026-08-14 monitor.
The health endpoint is live but did not expose the expected immutable revision in that monitor.
claims.falsifier_or_gate: Exact immutable revision identity plus authenticated end-to-end journey must pass on the real deployment.

claims.primary_claim: The retained control-plane design/evidence exists, but current real-host queue, worker, failure and throughput counters are unknown from this surface.
supported: A logical registry specification exists for 16,256 identities.
Logical identity count does not establish physical worker concurrency or useful completed work.
claims.falsifier_or_gate: Real host DB/WAL/process recovery and bounded crash/restart/provider qualification are required before scale claims.

claims.primary_claim: The deterministic synthetic latent-language diagnostic passes its frozen leakage-reduction mechanics gate.
supported: Synthetic normalized excess language-leakage reduction is 0.9583333333333334 against a >=0.90 gate.
Focused tests and a fail-closed verifier exist for the synthetic package.
claims.falsifier_or_gate: A separately preregistered real multilingual encoder study with dangerous controls is required for any external representation claim.

claims.primary_claim: The reduced-resistance representation strongly improves the frozen synthetic 1D pressure-MAE screen while maintaining negligible flux error.
supported: Mean pressure MAE decreases from 0.0658913916 to 0.0011366559 in the retained 20-seed screen.
Mean relative improvement is 97.8766% in that bounded screen.
Mean flux relative error is approximately 1.37e-16.
claims.falsifier_or_gate: Matched learned operator and reduced-order baselines plus 2D/OOD/misaligned physical regimes are required for promotion.

claims.primary_claim: The frozen equal-budget B3 experiment reproducibly fails both adverse-condition superiority gates while passing the clean-regression constraint.
supported: Unchanged replay reproduces the scientific metrics/hashes.
claims.falsifier_or_gate: v0.1 is closed negative. Any new mechanism is a new version/protocol and cannot retune v0.1.

claims.primary_claim: The retained real-data comparison is mixed/negative and raw/log ridge remains stronger on the frozen primary covariance-matrix MSE.
supported: The primary real-data baseline comparison reproduces as mixed/negative.
claims.falsifier_or_gate: Any successor study must preregister stronger spectral baselines and a primary metric hierarchy across multiple datasets.

claims.primary_claim: The controlled salience-dependent tradeoff reproduces and degrades/reverses under severe salience failure.
supported: Retained salience-dropout stress shows weakening/reversal regions.
claims.falsifier_or_gate: A new claim requires matched learned controls and preregistered realistic salience-reliability stress.

claims.primary_claim: Controlled diagnostic and companion learned evidence reproduce; natural-task/OOD transfer remains unestablished.
supported: Controlled mechanism evidence reproduces within the retained boundary.
claims.falsifier_or_gate: Strong learned memory controls plus a frozen natural/OOD task are required for promotion.

claims.primary_claim: Robust readout effects reproduce in the synthetic contamination screen, but the effect is not unique to a non-Gaussian learned memory mechanism.
supported: Robust aggregation effect reproduces.
Material benefit also appears in the 0% control.
claims.falsifier_or_gate: Learned mechanism must be evaluated separately with matched memory baselines and ablations.

claims.primary_claim: The exact-head frozen local-diffusion screen reproducibly fails the predeclared >75% improvement gate.
supported: Negative gate outcome reproduces under exact-head workflow evidence.
claims.falsifier_or_gate: Current result is closed negative; a real-PDE learned-operator study must be a new protocol.

claims.primary_claim: The current repository proves a durable local media-render pipeline, not a production video service.
supported: Real local MP4 encoding and verification.
Durable local queue lifecycle and bounded retries.
Content-addressed SHA-256-verified local artifact storage.
Current exact-head CI succeeds.
claims.falsifier_or_gate: Hosted worker/object-storage/auth lifecycle must be deployed and independently validated for product-production promotion.

claims.primary_claim: Architecture/runtime ideas exist; learned advantage is untested.
supported: Bounded architecture/runtime implementation where verified.
claims.falsifier_or_gate: One canonical bounded matched-budget learned experiment is required before re-entry.

claims.primary_claim: O0 roadmap/runtime exists; matched-provider O1 advantage is untested.
supported: Roadmap/runtime artifacts where verified.
claims.falsifier_or_gate: Freeze and run monolithic/full/minus-falsifier/minus-evidence-gate matched-provider O1 study before re-entry.
